entries.title: Psalms 108:1
segments: A Song, A Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and I will give praise, even [with] my glory.

entries.title: Psalms 108:2
segments: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awake early.

entries.title: Psalms 108:3
segments: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples; and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 108:4
segments: For Your mercy [is] great above the heavens; and Your truth [reaches] to the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 108:5
segments: Be lifted up, O God, above the heavens; and Your glory above all the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 108:6
segments: so that Your beloved may be delivered; save [with] Your right hand, and answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: God has spoken in His holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:8
segments: Gilead [is] Mine; Manasseh [is] Mine and Ephraim [is] the strength [of] My head; Judah [is] My lawgiver;

entries.title: Psalms 108:9
segments: Moab [is] My washpot; I will cast out My shoe over Edom; I will triumph over Philistia.

entries.title: Psalms 108:10
segments: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: O God, have You not cast us off? And, O God, will You not go out with our armies?

entries.title: Psalms 108:12
segments: Give us help from trouble; for vain [is] the deliverance of man.

entries.title: Psalms 108:13
segments: Through God we shall do mighty things; for He shall trample our enemies.
